args.summary:
Built and verified a spine-beam 2D model of a three-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete box-girder bridge (30+45+30 m, deck 12.5 m, carriageway 11.5 m).

Structure/system: continuous_on_piers (MR-05) since pier column geometry is given. The single-cell cast_box section was integrated exactly: A = 7.05 m², I = 4.7775 m⁴ (MR-02). C55 girder Ec = 35500 MPa, C40 piers Ec = 32500 MPa (JTG 3362-3.1.5); girder γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-4.2.1), giving w = 183.3 kN/m, m = 18.685 t/m (MR-07). Piers 1 and 2 modeled as elastic columns (H = 6 m and 29 m; twin Ø1.4 m columns combined: A = 3.0792 m², I = 0.3771 m⁴, MR-06).

Bearings (MR-03/MR-04, JTG 3362-8.7): abutments 0 and 3 and Pier 2 use PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric bearings (longitudinally free, Kh = 0), two per line; Pier 1 uses plain laminated elastomeric fixed bearings (longitudinally spring), two per line. Shape factors S and stiffnesses computed from the manufacturer's Ge = 1.2 MPa: S = 10.10/14.69/13.54/10.10; Kv = 3.614e6/8.974e6/8.075e6/3.614e6 kN/m; Pier-1 Kh = 13091 kN/m.

Live load (JTG D60-2015 Class I, one-way, 3 lanes): qk = 10.5 kN/m; Pk = 320/350/320 kN for spans 1–3; ξ = 0.78. Modal analysis gave f1 = 3.239 Hz, so impact factor μ = 0.1767·ln(f1) − 0.0157 = 0.1920 (JTG D60-4.3.2).

Results: self-weight reactions 1811/7843/7735/1858 kN; self-weight mid-span moments 6546/18945/7244 kN·m and support moments −28150/−26755 kN·m; lane-load max positive moment 11254 kN·m, max negative moment −8975 kN·m. All generated-model L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
